ACS residence estimates and LODES workplace-job records remain separate statistical universes.

qualityChecks.detail: All public rows resolve to the nine-county Bay Area.
No inherited observation is dropped or invented.
Every inherited measure has a namespaced definition.
Snapshot counts are inherited without deduplicating distinct release records.
Every observation retains one or more source identifiers.
Every derived measure exposes its formula or exact method.
Every source drill-down uses an official or documented HTTPS landing page.
Every curated profile measure covers every county at one common period.
Every comparison uses one common period and alphabetical county order.
County rows are never sorted by indicator value.
All applicable ACS rows retain 90% margins of error.
No equity score, county ranking, or causal inference is introduced.
The held narrative report is not published.
The public-use layer contains descriptive interfaces, not automated conclusions.
